title: Door Knocking
blurb: Three firm raps, and suddenly there is a plot. A knock is one of the most narratively loaded sounds available — who is it, why now, and is anybody going to answer? Film and radio drama have leaned on it for a century, since it builds suspense without a single word of dialogue. Drop it into edits for an incoming visitor, into a call to invent a mysterious guest and escape a meeting, or behind somebody wearing headphones for a jump scare with total plausible deniability. Knock knock. You are welcome.
